messages.author: 348b53139bc4b608
messages.subject: Exclude similar loci
parts:
Hi Dr. Broman and the R/QTL community,

I noticed there is a feature in JoinMap where you can exclude similar loci. I have 1265 loci that are 100% similar and would like to exclude one from each identical pair. Is there a command that can identify the identicals and drop one in R/QTL?

Thanks!

messages.author: 151953465baea91d
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Exclude similar loci
parts:
Hi Lara,

This function in R/qtlTools has the capacity.

https://github.com/jtlovell/qtlTools/blob/master/R/dropSimilarMarkers.R

Cheers,
Josh

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Exclude similar loci
parts:
A related R/qtl function is findDupMarkers(), which looks for markers with identical genotype data. 
And then drop.markers() to remove them.

karl
